critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: ProjectDetailPage.jsx line 185-186 was converting dates to ISO format (toISOString()) but backend expects YYYY-MM-DD format. Changed to pass dates as-is.
Date validation in ProjectsPage.jsx handleCreateProject() correctly validates: empty start_date, empty end_date, end_date < start_date
Date validation in CreateTaskDialog.jsx handleSubmit() correctly validates: empty start_date, empty due_date, due_date < start_date
Both dialogs correctly show mandatory indicator (*) in red (text-destructive class) for date fields
Default dates are correctly set using getDefaultDates() helper function with date-fns format() and addDays()
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mandatory date fields feature fully tested and working. Projects and Tasks both have: 1) Required date fields with asterisk indicator, 2) Default dates (today + 10 days), 3) Frontend validation for empty dates and invalid date ranges. Fixed bug in ProjectDetailPage.jsx where task dates were being converted to ISO format instead of YYYY-MM-DD.
